meta.title: Get in Touch — UnLitigate
meta.description: Tell us what's happening. Two minutes. Plain words. You choose what to share. Please don't share ID or bank details.

hero.heading: Tell us what's happening
hero.body: Two minutes. Plain words. You choose what to share.

items.heading: You fill a short form
items.body: Name, city, the kind of dispute, and a few lines on what's going on.

items.heading: We read it and reply
items.body: A person reads what you sent. We do not ask for ID or bank details.

items.heading: We explain your options
items.body: Including whether mediation may suit you — and when it may not.

form.note: Please don't share ID or bank details.

other.heading: Other ways
other.body: If a form is not right for you, write or send a message.
